dedupe_keys.name: bangladesh national grid daily day and evening peak demand

description: This CSV provides daily national-grid demand peaks for Bangladesh from 1 January 2016 through 30 September 2024. The repository says it assembled day and evening maxima from monthly Power Grid Bangladesh PLC operational spreadsheets and reports 3,196 daily observations. Both demand fields are in megawatts at the generation end; the stated time zone is Bangladesh Standard Time. A modeller could use the series to fit aggregate peak-demand scenarios or compare forecast errors over seasons and structural load growth. It has no temperature, holiday or regional feeder fields, so it cannot directly calibrate local distribution loads. The README calls the date format ISO-8601 while its field example says DD-MM-YYYY; this review did not inspect the CSV to settle that conflict. Nor did it compare source monthly reports or check extreme values. GitHub metadata and the README state CC0-1.0 for the repository, while rights in the original PGCB reports remain to be checked. Related resources are the PGCB operational spreadsheets and weather covariates, which have separate provenance.
licence: CC0-1.0 in GitHub repository metadata and README; original PGCB report terms were not independently checked.
